Space Echo listening comparison

RE-201-inspired Tape with the original twelve head modes and a synthetic spring. This compares our models using the same synthesized phrase. It is not a recording of Roland hardware.

Play the instrument. Choose Tape model → Space Echo, then turn Tape On. Try mode 11 for all three heads and spring, or mode 12 for spring alone.

Renders silently. Press Play on a clip when ready to listen.



The clips use one common gain, with no individual normalization. The tape path is mono; the direct sound stays stereo. Pitch glides, spring response and saturation are designed approximations. Wear headphones and start at a low volume before trying high feedback.
